weather_report:
Subiaco wakes under a clean, blue morning, the air still a touch crisp but softening as the sun climbs. By late morning the sky is set to stay mostly clear, the light turning bright and honest, with visibility sharp enough to make colors feel freshly painted. Through early afternoon a few gentlemanly clouds may wander by without changing the mood. Expect a moderate UV push around midday; shade, sunglasses, and a dab of sunscreen will be kind to you even in late winter.

It looks like a day for light layers and a hat, something you can peel off when the sun leans warm on your shoulders. Take your coffee outdoors, let a short errand become a small walk, and choose the sunny side of the street. By midday, lunch on a bench or a quiet read by a window will feel unreasonably pleasant; later, a gentle spin on the bike or a lap through the neighborhood will close the afternoon neatly. Nothing dramatic, just clear, steady weather that invites you out and promises to keep you company.
